verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Gemini's consumer app features (uploads, image generation, Live conversation, Gems, notebooks) and community sentiment about model quality/pricing, but contains no documentation of an API versioning scheme or a deprecation policy for any Gemini API. The one API-related community note (gemini-comm-8) only discusses pricing differences across model versions, not a documented deprecation process, and the probe explicitly notes the assistant app has no discoverable API/agent-docs surface distinct from the separate ai.google.dev product.
